title: Business thesis and constraints
decision: Build a useful education-and-application business; keep subscriptions optional.
blocking_evidence: Founder hours, maximum loss, desired income, commercial scope

title: Market and competitor landscape
decision: Differentiate through decision support, transparent uncertainty, and useful applications.
blocking_evidence: Thirty listing observations complete; full-video/transcript coding and smaller/inactive creator sample remain

title: ICP and customer jobs
decision: Test recreational lifters with recurring schedule, time, or equipment friction.
blocking_evidence: No interviews completed or willingness-to-pay validated

title: Positioning and brand
decision: Preserve Project Fitness and DEX as the pilot direction; test the clarity of the promise.
blocking_evidence: Name/handle clearance and final owned character rig

title: Evidence and editorial
decision: Keep every material claim traceable and pending until reviewed.
blocking_evidence: Newer-trial retrieval, study overlap, complete appraisal and approval

title: Content strategy
decision: Launch one decision cluster with three related pilot topics.
blocking_evidence: Actual audience relevance and search/browse performance

title: Creative production
decision: Use deterministic cards for the first sequence test and preserve recording-first final production.
blocking_evidence: Human narration, final rig, visual review, provider-account benchmarks

title: GTM and distribution
decision: Use YouTube for discovery, a relevant free resource for application, and email for a continuing relationship.
blocking_evidence: No channel access, public release, native tests or acquisition results yet

title: Owned audience and lifecycle
decision: Offer one useful worksheet with clear consent and dependable delivery.
blocking_evidence: Email account, domain, consent text and end-to-end delivery verification

title: Product and monetization
decision: Test a guided decision toolkit; earn a subscription through repeat use.
blocking_evidence: No checkout, sales or repeat-use cohort

title: Customer success and retention
decision: Define activation as completing a useful decision, and recurrence as another relevant use.
blocking_evidence: No customer or renewal data

title: Economics and finance
decision: Measure cash and human time separately; model prices as scenarios.
blocking_evidence: Budget, actual fees, taxes, labor rates and measured fulfillment

title: Shared knowledge and learning
decision: Separate sourced observations, approved policy, current state, and experiment decisions.
blocking_evidence: Holdout retrieval evaluation and real operational incidents

title: Workflow and agent architecture
decision: Use deterministic transitions and bounded AI-assisted tasks.
blocking_evidence: Real provider integration and authenticated turuan reuse

title: Technology and integrations
decision: Keep Python, Pillow and FFmpeg; start with local SQLite state and provider-neutral imports.
blocking_evidence: GitHub authentication, provider accounts, email/billing setup

title: Data and measurement
decision: Give every observation a unit, denominator, period and source.
blocking_evidence: Real Studio exports, customer events, attribution and revenue reconciliation

title: Evaluations and reliability
decision: Test costly failure paths before unattended operation.
blocking_evidence: Live outage drill, restored external media backup, expert-labeled holdout

title: Rights and commercial operations
decision: Keep asset provenance and actual offer obligations visible.
blocking_evidence: Name clearance, vendor terms, jurisdiction-specific review; no legal clearance claimed

title: Execution and resourcing
decision: Limit work in progress to three pilot topics and their two experimental sequences.
blocking_evidence: Weekly capacity and actual reviewer availability

title: Expansion and reuse
decision: Prove the shared contracts on fitness before launching another new niche.
blocking_evidence: Validated first-brand economics, second-domain competence and code-level migration review
